parameters.name: EarliestRemediationTime
parameters.description: The earliest time. This parameter is empty by default. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss without a time zone identifier.

parameters.name: LatestRemediationTime
parameters.description: The latest time. This parameter is empty by default. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss without a time zone identifier.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that marks the position from which to start reading. If this parameter is left empty, data is read from the beginning.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

You can obtain the resource type from the **Resource Type** column in [Cloud services that support resource groups](~~94479~~).

parameters.name: Service
parameters.description:
The cloud service ID.

You can obtain the cloud service ID from the **Cloud Service Code** column in [Cloud services that support resource groups](~~94479~~).

parameters.name: TargetResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the target resource group for remediation.
